## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated / 已新增或更新针对性测试
- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm e2e` when UI or API behavior changes / UI 或 API 变更时已运行
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes / 视觉变更已附截图

## DAYU boundaries / 产品边界

- [ ] Findings still cite valid Evidence IDs / 发现仍引用有效 Evidence ID
- [ ] Missing data lowers coverage, not risk / 缺失数据只降低覆盖度，不增加风险
- [ ] Copy reports risk or mismatch and does not claim bought stars, fraud, or intent / 文案只报告风险或不协调，不指控买星、欺诈或主观意图
- [ ] Chinese and English facts, scores, and caveats remain equivalent / 中英文事实、分数和限制一致
- [ ] No token, private-repository content, or sensitive log is introduced / 未引入令牌、私有仓库内容或敏感日志
